title: One Piece of Flock Camera Data Put This Innocent Woman in Jail for 13 Days
summary: A news article and Hacker News discussion about how Flock license-plate-reading camera data led to the wrongful arrest of an innocent woman, Lindsey Isaacs, who was jailed for 13 days in Palm Beach, Florida. The case highlights risks of AI-powered surveillance and automated data matching, raising concerns about accuracy, oversight, and civil liberties in law enforcement deployment.
